source: ONS Census 2021 RM021 — Economic activity status by passports held, by local authority district. NOMIS NM_2121_1.
caveat: Stock measure on Census Day (21 March 2021). Passports-held is a proxy for nationality (UK = UK passport holder). Employment rate excludes full-time students from the denominator (the standard ONS definition). The 'inactive' category includes retirees, full-time students who do not work, those looking after family, long-term sick, and other reasons.
